BiblicalUsage: Harim is a name carried by several men, and the clearest is the priest whose course fell third in David's ordering. The children of Harim returned from exile a thousand and seventeen, Malchijah the son of Harim repaired a portion of the wall, and the third lot of the priests came forth to Harim.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the three mentions show one family across the whole story: a priestly course under David, a returning family under Zerubbabel, and a wall-builder under Nehemiah. I hold that God keeps a family through exile the same way He kept its course.
